## Would this be useful in a real workflow?

If yes, describe the decision, evidence source, institution, research task, or policy problem where it might be useful. Interest alone is not treated as a pilot commitment.

## External evidence or pilot interest

If you may have an attributable dataset, meter/inverter export, institutional evidence object, or pilot context, describe only the format and constraints here. Do not post private customer data or secrets.

Do not post private keys, seed phrases, API tokens, customer-identifying energy data, confidential contracts, or data you do not have permission to share.
